summary: Continental Army officer and Culper Ring courier (1747–1827); once counted a Brewster cousin of John, but that Brewster descent is probably disproven.
bio:
Caleb Brewster was born on 12 September 1747 and died on 13 February 1827. He served as an officer in the Continental Army and as the courier of the Culper spy ring, carrying its messages across Long Island Sound under the code number 725. He has sometimes been credited with Mayflower descent, but a Brewster family researcher rejects that claim.

He was once placed as John's 3rd cousin 9 times removed through the Brewster family, but that Brewster ancestry has probably been disproven, so no blood relationship to John is known.
